summary: Creative AI drawing game. Toyform your very own planet with 3D artworks!
description:
In Toyforming, your drawings will come to three-dimensional life with the power of artificial intelligence (AI) and will inhabit a planet all of your own making. Your 3D artwork will have a mind of its own and interact with its surroundings. Turn on AR Mode to merge reality with your toyformed reality!

Winner of 4Gamer.net's Media Highlight Award at BitSummit X-Roads 2022, the biggest indie games conference in Japan!

GET CREATIVE
Draw anything you want and see what the AI will make of it. You can customize and adapt your artwork to be as real or abstract as you want. The only thing that will restrict what you can create is your imagination.
Toyforming is all about fun for kids and adults to help nurture the creative mind. Family and friends can play together to create a vibrant and unique world. If you can dream it, you can make it!

SMART AI AND INTERACTIVE WORLD
The AI in Toyforming will try to figure out what you were drawing and add the movement and behavior to your artwork. Once placed on your planet, all the artworks will come alive and interact with all the surrounding environment and other objects. What will the AI make of your drawings? 
Some objects can change the planet’s environment like clouds that will make it rain and make the rivers and sea or the moon that will turn the planet to night so you can see things in a whole new light. All objects in Toyforming has its own behavior so get drawing and see how they come to life!

SAVE AND SHARE
All of your drawings can be saved in the app so you can place your favorite animals and items on different planets. If you share the saved data with your friends and family, you can have your artwork appear on their planets too! There's even a button that will hide the UI so you can take the perfect screenshot to share online with the world. Now, you can share your planet with others by posting it in the Observatory, our new in-app sharing feature!

AR MODE
Toyforming had different backgrounds to choose from but you can also turn on AR Mode so you can see your planet in different settings like your bedroom, living room, backyard or even outside at the park or mall. You can even get a screenshot of your planet with yourself!
